title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Dominican University of California
description: A guide to the essential late-night food and study spots for students at Dominican University of California, featuring on-campus options and local San Rafael favorites.

cards.title: Caleruega Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Main Dining
cards.notes: Visit the main campus hub for late-night mobile orders through the DU To Go service, providing hot meals until 9:00 PM on weekdays.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus dining facility offering a variety of food concepts and a dedicated late-evening mobile ordering service.
cards.evidence_claim: Caleruega Dining Hall offers 'DU To Go' mobile ordering Monday through Thursday from 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open for DU To Go until 9:00 PM Mon-Thu; until 8:00 PM Fri-Sun.

cards.title: Chilly's Café
cards.subtitle: Guzman Hall Coffee Spot
cards.notes: Stop by Guzman Hall for coffee, tea, and desserts in a social campus setting that stays open until 8:00 PM most weeknights.
cards.short_summary: An independent on-campus café known for its specialty coffee, Arabic savories like kunafa, and evening study atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Chilly's Café is located at Guzman Hall and is open Monday through Thursday until 8:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Chilly's Café - San Rafael, CA | joe coffee
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7:45 AM - 8:00 PM; Friday 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM.

cards.title: Jack in the Box
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Drive-Thru
cards.notes: Head to 2nd Street for a full menu available 24/7, including breakfast items and late-night munchie meals just a short drive from campus.
cards.short_summary: A reliable 24-hour fast-food destination in downtown San Rafael serving burgers, tacos, and breakfast all day.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jack in the Box at 1814 2nd St in San Rafael operates its drive-thru and lobby 24 hours a day.
cards.source_title: Jack In The Box in San Rafael, California
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and lobby are open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: 7-Eleven
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Convenience Hub
cards.notes: Grab quick snacks, hot food, or beverages at any hour from this downtown convenience staple located near the transit center.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store providing essential snacks and quick-service hot food for late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 703 B St in San Rafael is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for walk-in and mobile checkout.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Mexican Fast Food
cards.notes: Drive over for classic tacos and burritos available until midnight daily, perfect for a post-study snack run.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night fast-food chain in San Rafael offering a customizable menu of Mexican-inspired favorites.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell at 555 Second Street in San Rafael is open until 12:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in San Rafael, CA - 555 Second Street
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 10:00 AM to 12:00 AM.

cards.title: Safeway
cards.subtitle: Midnight Grocery Run
cards.notes: Stock up on dorm essentials or grab a late-night deli sandwich at this supermarket that stays open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A large grocery store in downtown San Rafael providing a wide selection of food and household items until late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Safeway at 700 B St in San Rafael is open daily until 12:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Safeway Locations in San Rafael, CA
cards.access_notes: Store hours are 6:00 AM to 12:00 AM daily.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger
cards.subtitle: California Classic Late-Night
cards.notes: Join the late-night queue for a Double-Double and animal-style fries at this iconic regional chain open until 1:00 AM or later.
cards.short_summary: A quintessential California burger joint located just south of campus, serving fresh burgers and shakes late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out Burger locations typically stay open until 1:00 AM on weeknights and 1:30 AM on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Open Sun-Thu until 1:00 AM; Fri-Sat until 1:30 AM.

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Diner Classics
cards.notes: Gather for a Grand Slam or late-night burger at this 24-hour diner, a staple for students needing a place to eat at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A classic American diner offering full breakfast, lunch, and dinner menus 24 hours a day in San Rafael.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's is a 24-hour diner and breakfast restaurant with locations serving late-night food 24/7.

cards.title: Cyber Café
cards.subtitle: Archbishop Alemany Library
cards.notes: Utilize this library-based café for grab-and-go snacks and study space during regular library operating hours.
cards.short_summary: Located in the lower level of the library, this café offers sandwiches, salads, and a convenient place to study on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cyber Café is located in the lower level of the library and is open Monday through Friday until 5:00 PM during regular sessions.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; closed weekends.

cards.title: Black Bear Diner
cards.subtitle: Hearty Evening Meals
cards.notes: Enjoy large portions of comfort food until 9:00 PM or 10:00 PM, making it a great spot for a late dinner near campus.
cards.short_summary: A bear-themed diner known for its sizable helpings of home-style food and friendly service in San Rafael.
cards.evidence_claim: Black Bear Diner in San Rafael is open until 9:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and until 10:00 PM Friday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Thu/Sun until 9:00 PM; Fri-Sat until 10:00 PM.
